note: City-run campground on Burlington Bay of Lake Superior at the east edge of Two Harbors, on the North Shore, beside its own Burlington Bay Beach and the Sonju lakeshore trail. The sites sold as lakeside look over the bay across a shrubby bank. Books up far ahead in summer. --Claude
summary: City page, 2027 rate PDF, map, cancellation policy and Firefly read: base $45 (May/Oct) / $48 (peak) Burlington non-lakeside up to $68 full-hookup lakeside, +$2 Fri-Sat, 13.375% tax; season May 7-Oct 18 2027; Firefly booking opening Jan 1; 136 RV sites with pull-throughs, 30/50 A, some sewer; wifi and dump. Recommends coastal walk over lakeview.
flags: WATERFRONT lakeview -> coastal walk (recommend). Every loop is an easy walk to the Lake Superior shore over the park's own lawn, Burlington Bay Beach and park roads: the Burlington loop (sites 1-66) and Agate loop (67-102) lie between Highway 61 and the shore with nothing else in between, and the David Dill Addition (1B-34B) and tent sites are about 250-400 m from the beach across Park Road (a park/local road). Highway 61 is on the inland side only. Lakefront not earned: the Agate lakeside pads (about 74-84, around 47.0275,-91.6582) sit 30-40 m back behind a continuous shrub/young-tree band on the bank; most Burlington lakeside pads (around 47.0264,-91.6608) are behind a 15-25 m shrub band; only the north-east tip of the Burlington east lobe (one or two pads about 47.0268,-91.6603, probably sites 48-49 by the map) is 40-55 m from the water over open grass and cobble beach, too few and too marginal to call clear. The operator's own 'Lakeside' site classes (Burlington Lakeside, Agate Lakeside) support the view value either way.
The city's campground map still says 'To book online visit www.reserveamerica.com'; the page's booking link and the operator's engine are Firefly. booking written as operator/Firefly.
Price gate does not apply (city-owned); the base $48 peak / $45 non-peak is under $50 before 13.375% tax anyway.
Season: Firefly gives the 2027 dates May 7 - October 18; the city page's general wording is mid-May to mid-October. Written from Firefly.
Phone 218-834-2021 and website confirmed (page also gives burlingtonbaycampground@twoharborsmn.gov). Pin is inside the Burlington loop; no move.
Showers stay as stored (derived): the map shows two bathhouses but no page says showers.
Not read: Firefly's per-site catalog (site lengths, minimum stays) needs the JS engine; no headless run was made for it.
